summary: RisuAI exports a character as .charx zip with card.json assets and sometimes module.risum of regex trigger and lorebook rows. What Hoplight reads: .charx cards lorebook .json or .lorebook and regex as .risum or bare JSON rows; detect by zip and card.json not filename. What comes across cleanly keeps the original and lifts core fields greetings group-only Risu additional text creator notes dates display settings bias words image-gen voice scripts as data never run privileged flag as warning only embedded lorebook; images ride as bytes and may not preview live because of internal refs. What changes when you convert to another app keeps same-app fields assets scripts though not guaranteed identical archive bytes; cross-app drops Risu behavior surface scripts display package ids. Editing on the Workbench has Workshop tab for script data; bundled .risum is look do not touch and edit blocks export. Exporting back out writes .charx with linked lorebook in character_book; media only survives same-app Risu round trip not foreign pictures yet. Common questions cover semantic exactness not byte identity preview scripts risum edit block and lorebook put-back.

sections.title: What Hoplight reads
sections.summary: Hoplight reads RisuAI cards as .charx a zip holding card.json plus assets folder of images and sometimes a bundled module.risum package. Lorebooks export as plain .json or .lorebook. Regex scripts arrive as a .risum module with rule rows or a bare .json list of rows. Drop on the Library for a plain-words receipt. Recognition uses zip signature and card.json entry not filename so renamed exports still import. Full walkthrough lives in the importing guide.

sections.title: What comes across cleanly
sections.summary: Importing loses nothing. Hoplight keeps a complete original then lifts name nickname description personality scenario first message alternate and group-only greetings examples system post-history Risu additional text creator notes including per-language source license tags dates display settings view screen large portrait inlay utility bot lore plus bias words image-gen hints voice config regex trigger virtual script background HTML/CSS default variables module toggles prebuilt-asset config privileged flag as warning marker never executed and embedded lorebook. Script rows never run; Hoplight parses edits and writes them as plain data. Every image rides as background bytes; Risu internal image refs mean live Workbench preview is not always available though bytes export back. Bundled .risum package is kept whole.

sections.title: What changes when you convert to another app
sections.summary: Same-app round-trip keeps everything you can see and touch though not necessarily the same bytes: fields assets and script rows come back when exported to RisuAI. Converting to another app drops Risu private extras on purpose: display settings additional text and the whole behavior surface regex trigger virtual script background HTML/CSS default variables module toggles prebuilt-asset config privileged flag plus bundled .risum package internal ids bookkeeping. Core character and embedded lorebook come across as far as the target holds; bias image-gen voice only if matching slots. Another app means SillyTavern Agnai Backyard RoleCall Pygmalion. Never blind-copy scripts; they stay where they work. Fewer target slots drop on their side not yours.

sections.title: Editing on the Workbench
sections.summary: Send a piece to the Workbench as a tab and edit name description personality scenario first message and example messages like any card. Save writes the whole card so untouched parts stay. Cards with Risu scripts get a second tab Workshop for regex rows trigger rows virtual script background HTML/CSS and default variables as data you read and edit never run. If a separate .risum package is bundled Workshop shows its contents as look do not touch for now: editing the package and exporting is currently blocked rather than risk a broken write-back. Leave it as imported and it exports whole.

sections.title: Exporting back out
sections.summary: Stage for the Press; each run exports staged pieces to one target. Hoplight writes RisuAI cards as .charx the same zip container Risu exports so it loads like any Risu export. A linked lorebook rides written into character_book the slot Risu reads on import. Plain .txt or .md available for reading text. Other app targets apply the drop story. Gap: if a piece picture came from a different app exporting to RisuAI currently leaves .charx with no images; media only survives same-app Risu round trip where original archive files ride untouched. A picture from elsewhere has nowhere to land in a Risu export yet.

sections.title: Common questions
sections.summary: Will the card come back exactly as it was? In every way that matters yes on export to RisuAI: every field asset and script row survives but exact .charx bytes are not guaranteed because Hoplight rebuilds the archive and re-prints JSON so spacing compression and entry order can shift. Imported .charx returns as .charx. Picture bytes always ride on same-app round trip; live Workbench preview depends on Risu internal refs. Regex and trigger scripts stay on the Risu card and are not copied cross-app; on Workbench they are data never run. Bundled .risum can be opened and looked at; leave alone to export whole; edit currently blocks export so change packages in RisuAI for now. Embedded worldbook is pulled for solo edit and put back into character_book on export to apps that read one.
